summary: GDS Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing two exhibits: a press release announcing it will report third quarter 2026 unaudited financial results after the Hong Kong close and before the U.S. open on November 25, 2026, with a management call at 7:00 AM ET, and a Hong Kong announcement of the board meeting date. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings-calendar and board-meeting notice. The only notable structural reference is the company's weighted voting rights regime. What to watch: the November 25 results and any capital-markets activity disclosed therein.
